newsitem.title: UK: Computer chip shares boost London Japanese stocks.
newsitem.headline: Computer chip shares boost London Japanese stocks.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to slightly firmer on Wednesday, with semi-conductor stocks continuing Tokyo's rise on hopes for a recovery in spot prices for computer chips, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was up 0.6 point at 1,446.17 after the Nikkei 225 Average ended trade 178.68 points higher at 21,350.67 on institutional buying of chip stocks.
"There were quite spectacular moves last night in semi-conductors and that has carried on to a degree here. Fujitsu Ltd, NEC and, to a lesser extent, Hitachi are firm," one dealer said.

Traders were sceptical the gains would continue. The sector rise was triggered by hopes for a sharp rebound in 16 megabit dram chip prices but dealers said there was scepticism that the market had bottomed out.

Other related stocks were higher but the remainder of the market was quiet, with a firm undertone, traders said. They said shares were little moved by the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee's decision to leave U.S. rates unchanged.
